contexts.text: The land of Havilah () = the mind.

The land of Havilah... is also mentioned in , where it treats of the sons of Ishmael, that they dwelt from Havilah even to Shur, which is by the faces of Egypt, by which one comes into Asshur. They who are in a heavenly idea do not perceive from these things anything but intelligence, and the things which How from intelligence...
They dwelt from Havilah even to Shur... Havilah = that which is of intelligence.
They resided from Havilah even to Shur... = the extension of intelligence.
The good of Knowledges [is also signified by gold from Havilah ().
